title: HorizonMC
description: HorizonMC is a competitive Lifesteal SMP featuring bounties, auction house, player economy, ranks, shops, PvP, events, and an active community. Steal hearts, build your empire, and dominate the server.
body:
⚔️ Welcome to HorizonMC ⚔️

HorizonMC is a feature-rich Lifesteal SMP where every battle matters. Defeat players to steal their hearts, grow stronger, and climb to the top of the server.

🌟 Server Features
❤️ Lifesteal System
💰 Player Economy
🎯 Bounty System
🏪 Server Shop
🔨 Auction House
👑 Custom Ranks & Perks
🏠 Homes & Teleports
📦 Crates & Rewards
⚔️ Competitive PvP
🎉 Frequent Events
🛡️ Active Staff Team
🌎 Friendly Community

Whether you are a skilled PvP player, a wealthy trader, or a dedicated grinder, HorizonMC offers endless opportunities to build your legacy.
